fusions.name: Tuned Tangle
fusions.desc: Looses a cone of charged strands, dealing 4 damage to everything caught in it. Each hit has a 30% chance of [Muddled], slowing the target's casting for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Unraveling Cast
fusions.desc: A cast that deals 40 damage, up to 1.3 times that at maximum range, ignoring the target's resistances.

fusions.name: Drawn from the Weave
fusions.desc: Restores 4 mana a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Backflow
fusions.desc: When you spend mana, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
